name: TC-AN-QB-008 — 清空按钮：二次确认后清空测试数据 [P0]
description: 审核节点编辑页已打开，通过批量填写导入测试数据后执行清空
module: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row'); if (rows.length > 0) { const editBtn = rows[0].querySelector('a[href*=edit], button'); if (editBtn) { editBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false }; })()
(() => { /* 记录存量参与人数(不动) */ const c = document.querySelector('[class*=selectedLabel]'); return { existingCount: c ? c.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-selection-item').length : -1 }; })()
steps.description: 记录存量参与人数(不清空)

steps.text: ═══ Phase 1: 批量填写造测试数据 ═══

steps.expression: (() => { const batchBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim() === '批量填写'); if (batchBtn) { batchBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal'); if (!modal) return { found: false }; const textarea = modal.querySelector('textarea'); const testData = JSON.stringify([{empId:'421225',empName:'宗育'},{empId:'320729',empName:'澜蓝'}]); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(textarea, testData); textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return { found: true, testDataCount: 2 }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal'); const confirmBtn = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim() === '确认导入'); if (confirmBtn) { confirmBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

steps.text: ═══ Phase 2: 清空(仅清空自己造的测试数据) ═══

steps.expression: (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const clearBtn = btns.find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('清空')); if (!clearBtn) return { found: false, error: '未找到清空按钮' }; clearBtn.click(); return { found: true, clicked: true }; })()

(() => { const popoverBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-popover button, .ant-popconfirm button, .ant-popover-buttons button'); const confirmBtn = Array.from(popoverBtns).find(b => (b.textContent || '').trim() === '确认清空'); const cancelBtn = Array.from(popoverBtns).find(b => (b.textContent || '').trim() === '取消'); return { hasPopover: popoverBtns.length > 0, hasConfirmBtn: !!confirmBtn, hasCancelBtn: !!cancelBtn, btnTexts: Array.from(popoverBtns).map(b => b.textContent.trim()) }; })()
steps.description: 验证二次确认气泡出现

steps.expression: (() => { const popoverBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-popover button, .ant-popconfirm button, .ant-popover-buttons button'); const confirmBtn = Array.from(popoverBtns).find(b => (b.textContent || '').trim() === '确认清空'); if (confirmBtn) { confirmBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { /* 验证清空后回到存量状态(测试数据被清除) */ const c = document.querySelector('[class*=selectedLabel]'); const currentCount = c ? c.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-selection-item').length : -1; return { currentCount, note: '清空后应为存量数据(测试数据已清除)' }; })()
steps.description: 验证测试数据已被清空

_testDesign.preconditions: 审核节点编辑页已打开（不修改存量数据）
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 通过「批量填写」导入2条测试数据
2. 点击「清空」按钮
3. 弹出二次确认气泡
4. 点击「确认清空」
_testDesign.expectedResult: 1. 二次确认气泡出现，含「确认清空」和「取消」两个按钮\n2. 确认后测试数据被清空\n3. 存量参与人不受影响（清空是全量操作，因此实际也会清空存量 — 此用例仅验证清空功能本身可用）
_testDesign.groupPath: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮
